'''2005 Michigan Mini-Open Brandon Pahl LS You Can Either Profit By This...''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brandon Pahl]] at [[2005 Michigan Mini-Open]], finishing 1st; the list below is as posted on DeckTech by Brandon "Mr. blp" Pahl (2005-03-31).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=34643 Big Disco Party]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050923181506/http://www.decktech.net:80/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=34643 Internet Archive]</ref>
